verdict: Setup milestones are overdue; your reporting chain is being completed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no paid advertising ran, so all measurable activity came from organic sources — your Google Business Profile, website traffic, and search. Your profile generated 202 actions this period, including 61 calls and 84 direction requests, which shows continued local presence. Three setup milestones — attribution repair, contact cleanup, and your live reporting dashboard — passed their due dates unresolved, and that is the priority this week; until they are complete, the full picture of how inquiries move from first contact to booked appointment cannot be reported cleanly. Each of those items is in progress now, and the dashboard and attribution work are the immediate focus so your scoreboard can reflect real numbers going forward.
